8.22.1.5. iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator.PiSPECConfigurator¶

class iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator.PiSPECConfigurator¶

The PiSPECConfigurator class

This class has four functionalities:

  • Store a rule - store_geoinst_rule() - store_piinst_rule() - store_pipred_rule()
  • Store a predicate - store_pred()
  • Generate pispec from the stored rules - generate()
  • Print documentation of the rules in reStructuredText format - write_rule_tables()

Methods

__init__() Creates the empty lists and dictionaries that will contain the stored rules and predicates.
generate(railyard) Creates and stores GeoInstRule:s from the c{railyard} and then generates pispec from its stored rules.
store_geoinst_rule(from_type, geo_type, doc) Create amd store a GeoInstRule in the geoinst_rules list.
store_piinst_rule(geo_type, pi_type, doc[, …]) Create and store a PiInstRule in the dictionary managed by piinst_rules.
store_pred(predicate[, geo_name, doc]) Store a predicate in the predicates dictionary and, if no name (c{geo_name}) was given, creates a new one.
store_pred_rule(geo_name, pi_name, …) Create and store a PiPredRule in the dictionary managed by pipred_rules.
write_rule_tables(file_name) Creates and fills a file with documentation of the rules in reStructuredText format.
